+# Dependency Planner
+
+A dependency-free TypeScript CLI for Bun that validates a task graph and produces a deterministic execution plan.
+
+## Usage
+
+```sh
+bun run src/cli.ts plan INPUT.json
+```
+
+Input format:
+
+```json
+{
+  "tasks": [
+    { "id": "lint", "duration": 1 },
+    { "id": "build", "duration": 3, "dependsOn": ["lint"] }
+  ]
+}
+```
+
+The command prints one JSON object containing the lexicographic topological `order`, concurrent `layers`, `earliest` start and finish times, `totalDuration`, and a deterministic `criticalPath`. Invalid input and dependency cycles are reported on stderr with a non-zero exit status.

90:   const state = new Map<string, number>();
91:   const stack: string[] = [];
92:   const stackIndex = new Map<string, number>();

94:   function visit(id: string): string[] | null {
95:     state.set(id, 1);
96:     stackIndex.set(id, stack.length);
97:     stack.push(id);
98: 
99:     const dependencies = [...byId.get(id)!.dependsOn].sort();
100:     for (const dependency of dependencies) {
101:       if (state.get(dependency) === 1) {
102:         return [...stack.slice(stackIndex.get(dependency)), dependency];
103:       }
104:       if (!state.has(dependency)) {
105:         const cycle = visit(dependency);
106:         if (cycle) return cycle;
107:       }
108:     }
109: 
110:     stack.pop();
111:     stackIndex.delete(id);
112:     state.set(id, 2);
113:     return null;
114:   }
115: 
116:   for (const id of [...byId.keys()].sort()) {
117:     if (!state.has(id)) {

120:     }
121:   }
122:   return null;
123: }

125: function plan(tasks: Task[]) {
126:   const byId = new Map(tasks.map((task) => [task.id, task]));
127:   const dependents = new Map<string, string[]>();
128:   const remainingDependencies = new Map<string, number>();
129: 
130:   for (const task of tasks) {
131:     dependents.set(task.id, []);
132:     remainingDependencies.set(task.id, task.dependsOn.length);
133:   }
134:   for (const task of tasks) {
135:     for (const dependency of task.dependsOn) dependents.get(dependency)!.push(task.id);
136:   }
137:   for (const ids of dependents.values()) ids.sort();
138: 
139:   const ready = tasks
140:     .filter((task) => task.dependsOn.length === 0)
141:     .map((task) => task.id)
142:     .sort();
143:   const order: string[] = [];
144: 
145:   while (ready.length > 0) {
146:     const id = ready.shift()!;
147:     order.push(id);
148:     for (const dependent of dependents.get(id)!) {
149:       const remaining = remainingDependencies.get(dependent)! - 1;
150:       remainingDependencies.set(dependent, remaining);
151:       if (remaining === 0) {
152:         ready.push(dependent);
153:         ready.sort();
154:       }
155:     }
156:   }
157: 
158:   if (order.length !== tasks.length) {
159:     const cycle = findCycle(tasks);
160:     fail(`dependency cycle: ${cycle!.join(" -> ")}`);
161:   }
162: 
163:   const layers: string[][] = [];
164:   const layerById = new Map<string, number>();
165:   const earliest: Record<string, Timing> = {};
166:   const criticalTo = new Map<string, string[]>();
167: 
168:   for (const id of order) {
169:     const task = byId.get(id)!;
170:     let layer = 0;
171:     let start = 0;
172:     let predecessorPath: string[] | null = null;
173: 
174:     for (const dependency of task.dependsOn) {
175:       layer = Math.max(layer, layerById.get(dependency)! + 1);
176:       const dependencyFinish = earliest[dependency].finish;
177:       const path = criticalTo.get(dependency)!;
178:       if (
179:         dependencyFinish > start ||
180:         (dependencyFinish === start &&
181:           (predecessorPath === null || compareSequences(path, predecessorPath) < 0))
182:       ) {
183:         start = dependencyFinish;
184:         predecessorPath = path;
185:       }
186:     }
187: 
188:     layerById.set(id, layer);
189:     (layers[layer] ??= []).push(id);
190:     earliest[id] = { start, finish: start + task.duration };
191:     criticalTo.set(id, [...(predecessorPath ?? []), id]);
192:   }
193: 
194:   for (const layer of layers) layer.sort();
195: 
196:   let totalDuration = 0;
197:   let criticalPath: string[] = [];

199:     const finish = earliest[id].finish;
200:     const path = criticalTo.get(id)!;
201:     if (
202:       finish > totalDuration ||
203:       (finish === totalDuration &&
204:         (criticalPath.length === 0 || compareSequences(path, criticalPath) < 0))
205:     ) {
206:       totalDuration = finish;
207:       criticalPath = path;
208:     }
209:   }

211:   return { order, layers, earliest, totalDuration, criticalPath };
